purpose: test-only G1-G6 decoder/oracle validating the P-1 byte-encoding contract (ENCODING-TABLE-P1.md rev 20)
status: OFF-GATE / SCRATCH; P-1 remains OPEN; this is not part of the Verdandi gate

grant.scope: scratch-tree decoder/oracle + independent hand-calculated fixtures + G1-G6 gate execution only
grant.recorded_in: AUTHORIZATION.md and ENCODING-TABLE-P1.md header (grant note, rev 20)
grant.not: not a test result, not a change in P-1 status, not a conformance claim, not candidate selection

five_conditions: No production candidate or frozen reference changes.
No production-reference freeze, candidate selection, promotion, or conformance claim.
Independent hand-calculated vectors, with injected-routing results explicitly labeled.
Separate verdicts for malformed input, semantic mismatch, and BLOCKED.
Reproducible logs, inputs, outputs, source hashes, and exit status.
exclusions_blocked_or_out_of_scope: D4-2 effects_range_root verification (the range-tree algorithm + proof format)
D8 trust (external provenance of the anchor)
candidate selection, production-reference freeze, promotion, conformance claim, P-1 ratification

frozen_dependency.role: the only semantic dependency: ecs._apply_ops (Tier-3 replay) and ecs.digest (conformance identity); byte-identical to the frozen SKULD-R2 ecs.py
frozen_dependency.must_remain: byte-identical; the build must never modify it

baseline_isolation.isolation_rule: the oracle writes only under p1-oracle/evidence/ and its own scratch temp; it never writes ecs.py, never writes outside p1-oracle/, and is checked for this by test_g6.

normative_constants_pinned_for_v0.note: VERSION's integer value is pinned to 0 for the v0 '-0' domains for this test build and checked by test P1V-constants; the spec pins the domain suffix '-0' and u16 width, and this records the integer chosen.

commit_boundaries.contents: Independent oracle skeleton and fixture format
G4-G5 records, replay, checkpoint and anchor tests
G6 reproducibility, seam tests, complete evidence

verdict_categories.MALFORMED: Tier-1/2 structural rejection (framing, domain, type, shape, resource limit)
verdict_categories.SEMANTIC: Tier-3 replay / commitment mismatch (well-formed but wrong)
verdict_categories.BLOCKED: not verifiable this milestone (D4-2 effects-root, below-boundary anchor) - never relabelled, never reported as a pass

independence: the oracle implements the grammar from ENCODING-TABLE-P1.md; expected bytes in fixtures are hand-written literals (with derivation comments), and expected hashes are hashlib.sha256 over those literals, never produced by the oracle's own encode path.
